name: Make Me Famous
source:
Make Me Famous follows the story of Emma and Chloe, two best friends and roommates who’ve just moved into their first apartment together. At first, their goal is simple: share their daily lives online, work part-time at a coffee shop, and grow their follower base little by little.

But in the world of Make Me Famous, followers aren’t just numbers—they’re everything. Followers replace everything, define your worth, and pressure you to transform into the “perfect” version of yourself just to survive.

Emma and Chloe must navigate friendship, love, and temptation while facing the darker side of social media: the obsession with beauty, exposure, and fame at any cost. It’s up to you, the player, to decide whether they’ll stay true to themselves or spiral deeper into a world where the body is currency and likes always come with a price.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/stanlock/about]Patreon[/url]]
